text: Short nodes now keep their own text (up to 90 characters for titles, 300 for abstracts, 800 for summaries) instead of an LLM call, and the summarizer in analyzers/src/semantic.ts is told to avoid narration and to add to the heading rather than repeat it (ANALYZER_VERSION 2). Zoom.tsx hides a body that only repeats its heading, and 9 cached "Prompt…", "User…" and "The assistant…" summaries were deleted for regeneration. Tests pass (51), the typecheck is clean, and a Haiku check turned t18's "Prompt asks to implement the project.json split" into "Project index and cursors leave the repo; per-session meta.json replaces it"; committed as b9ae2e0, not pushed.
